currentChange: Retain original PR request layout at4126940 and add verified-endpoint capability with safe-prefix compatibility defaults.

source.system: OpenMAIC production PostgreSQL via maic-ops-prod pg_query, data source openmaic_live
source.table: llm_calls, joined through published-course studies and PBL role sessions
source.selection: Fixed seed pbl-cache-long-20261116; up to200 candidate role-session rows/course. Prefer discussion/planner/coder/mentor with distinct learners, using availability and call counts, never cache outcomes. No prerequisite role session >=24 calls in scanned candidates (maximum21), so last12 calls of four sessions with >=16; courses1/2 calls13-24 of four sessions with >=24.

arms.new_v1: Original layout plus provider compatibility fix

replay.settings: Fresh independently isolated equal-length leading markers per arm, same chronological captured inputs/model/tools,16 output-token cap, requested thinking disabled. Generated outputs not executed or fed into later requests. Verified MaaS route uses explicit trailing capability in both arms.
replay.limitations: Source is real production history; rates are controlled replay results, not live-production monitoring or UI latency. Complete saved input, identical reconstructed tool schemas; original generation settings/JSONB argument insertion order not fully logged. Starting at a later window without replaying earlier calls makes each selected window first request cold. Recorded assistant output becomes new input without recreating original output-KV warmup.

ordinary111Definition: Earlier broader structural ordinary-turn mask from the same144source audit. Excludes first selected-window and welcome/stage/tool/prompt/recovery-projection boundaries; it does not require an unchanged fixed head. Not the strict stable-prefix diagnostic and never selected by cache ratio.
stable108Definition: Post-hoc structural diagnostic over all144source requests: require a previous selected record in the same role-session, byte-identical fixed head, identical serialized tool definitions, and the previous canonical message array as the exact serialized prefix of current history. This selects108records without using cache values. Both versions use identical108records. The current host-state tail may still change: not an entirely append-only HTTP body.

missAttribution.tokenizer: Official DeepSeek recipe V4 tokenizer; offline component estimates, not exact backend framing or V4.1 tokenizer proof
missAttribution.method: Exact input/cache/miss from API. Tail and genuinely new message/head text estimated offline; estimates capped at measured misses. Allocation assumes the request-only tail is uncached first, then allocates genuinely new text; this is a conservative accounting estimate, not independent backend token-boundary evidence. First window requests separate. Residual explicitly combines repeated-prefix reprocessing, backend framing, tokenization/rounding and unexplained cache effects; it is not all asserted to be a software defect. All buckets sum to exact misses per request. New content includes recorded assistant output that this capped replay does not regenerate.

compatibility.versionScope: Historical restored-layout measurement only; superseded by c9b6e6e user-role state tail. The placement option and validation were removed; no current deployment configuration is required.
compatibility.tests: Actual SDK serialized requests with mock endpoints that reject non-leading systems: Ollama/Gemma, vLLM/Mistral and unknown relays; verified opt-in/nativeDeepSeek and prefix-only SDK coverage. Not claimed as real self-hosted model inference tests.

historicalEvidence: Earlier early-session production sample72records measured41.59%->58.52% for prePR vs original layout. Separate later-window144-record primary replay measured30.88%->77.05%. Those are historical matched experiments, not baseline values spliced into this new two-arm run.
privacy: Numeric usage, coarse course/role/window metadata and aggregate hashes only. No learner text, responses, user/study/session identifiers or credentials.

prefixEventAudit.classification: Per-request structural event labels and eligibility flags are provided. All excluded diagnostic rows remain in the144record headline. Event groups may overlap.
